variants.reason: Awkward mixed colors and gold trophy structure
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a premium transparent RPG collectible trophy, named "씨나인 VIP", for an existing Korean game trophy display.

INPUT IMAGE ROLES:
Image 1 is the exact CNINE / C9 logo to incorporate prominently: a crowned snow-leopard head above a curling metallic C9 monogram, with its small chain and pendant. Preserve that recognizable face, crown, lettering geometry and cool silver/blue/rose metal coloring faithfully. This is the ONLY brand logo to use.
Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE only: polished sculptural fantasy game trophy with sharp gold-metal reflections, dimensional carved details and a clean readable silhouette. Do not copy its coin piles or green centerpiece.

PRIMARY REQUEST:
Create one complete luxurious trophy using the crowned leopard C9 emblem as its large central sculptural centerpiece. Mount the recognizable C9 logo upright above an elegant polished golden trophy stem and dark polished octagonal pedestal, framed by a restrained symmetrical gold laurel surround. The C9 logo is clearly visible and large; the leopard face and C9 shapes must never be obscured, simplified into another animal, or replaced with lettering. A small polished metal nameplate on the pedestal reads EXACTLY "씨나인 VIP" in clean legible Korean type. No other text.

Composition: single full trophy, centered front view with subtle depth, square canvas, all crown tips/laurel leaves/pedestal visible with comfortable 8% margins. Crisp readability at 200px. Refined high-end 3D painted fantasy game asset, rich but controlled gold highlights and small deep-red jewel accents, consistent with the supplied existing trophy style.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No floor plane, scenery, surrounding panel, opaque background, checkerboard, external glow cloud or drop shadow. All ornament and highlights stay attached to the trophy silhouette.
Strict constraints: use ONLY the crowned-leopard C9 logo from Image 1. No SOOP wordmark, infinity symbol or unrelated branding. No Santa characters, portraits, extra props, watermarks or unrequested text. Korean engraving exactly "씨나인 VIP".

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a REDESIGNED "씨나인 VIP" collectible trophy, one unified sculpture with the authentic C9 brand logo.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 is the ONLY approved C9 brand logo: crowned snow-leopard head, sculpted curling C9 monogram and its delicate chain/cross pendant. Preserve its recognizable face, crown and readable C9 geometry.
Image 2 is a REJECTED trophy draft. The user says it feels awkward and its colors do not match; do not repeat the generic bright-yellow-gold laurel cup or the detached cool logo sitting on a differently colored stand.

NEW DESIGN:
Design the complete trophy as one coherent premium PLATINUM / SILVER artwork. The crowned leopard and C9 monogram are the trophy itself. The bottom curves of the C and 9 transition naturally into two elegant short flowing silver supports, smoothly joining a compact sculpted silver octagonal plinth. All connecting shapes share the C9 logo's rounded flowing design language and beveled metallic construction. The emblem is supported, balanced and physically plausible, not pasted onto an unrelated trophy cup. No large surrounding wreath; keep the recognizable C9 silhouette clean and prominent. A restrained faceted pale-blue crystal inset may sit within the small plinth, not over the logo.

COLOR COHESION IS THE HIGHEST PRIORITY:
Match the approved logo's existing palette across EVERY component: lustrous neutral silver and platinum, restrained ice-blue reflections on the left, very subtle blush/rose-silver reflections on the right. The face, crown, C9 letters, supports, plinth and nameplate must share the same materials, lighting and color family. Rich polished metal with crisp deep-silver shadow planes and soft pearl highlights, a refined restrained saturation. NO yellow gold, orange highlights, bronze, red ruby, black-and-gold base or bright royal-blue pedestal. The whole trophy should read as one beautifully crafted silver object with coherent cool/soft-rose reflections.

The lower plinth has a small inset silver nameplate engraved with EXACTLY "씨나인 VIP", precise legible Korean lettering in dark silver, part of the same metalwork. No other words.

STYLE AND FRAMING:
High-end game trophy, polished detailed dimensional 3D painted render. Frontal view with slight visible depth, well-balanced upright proportions, full crown through pedestal inside a square canvas with 8% clear margins, centered. C9 logo stays large and readable at small inventory size. Carefully integrated thin chain/pendant as in the approved logo; nothing floating or covering the C9 lettering.
Genuine transparent alpha outside the trophy. Crisp clean silhouette with no smoky glow, no halos, no floor/shadow, no scenery, no black or white backdrop, no checkerboard.
No SOOP logo, infinity symbol, extra characters, watermark, laurel wreath or extra text. This is a complete structural redesign and harmonious recoloring based on Image 1, not the previous gold cup.
